title: Python Developer
description: Build and maintain internal recruiting tools using Python and FastAPI. The role focuses on clean REST APIs, reusable services, and readable code for a small product team.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze hiring funnel metrics and prepare weekly dashboards for the recruitment team. You will write SQL queries and turn raw sample data into simple, readable reports.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Create recruiter-facing interfaces with React and accessible CSS. You will work on job cards, filters, and responsive layouts for a fictional careers product.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Design REST services and JSON-based data workflows for job postings. The team values clear validation, careful error handling, and well-documented endpoints.

title: HR Intern
description: Support coordinators with screening checklists and interview scheduling. A learning-focused internship for candidates who enjoy organizing people processes.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate deployment of internal applications and monitor service health. This opening was closed after the hiring freeze and is kept for records.

title: Product Manager
description: Own the recruiter workspace roadmap and gather hiring-team feedback. This senior role was filled internally and archived for reference.

title: QA Tester
description: Test job search and filtering flows and report defects with clear reproduction steps. Part-time role for a detail-oriented tester.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Prototype ranking models that match fictional job descriptions with candidate skills. A fixed-term contract with a small applied research team.

title: Technical Writer
description: Write recruiter help guides and API usage notes for internal tools. The ideal candidate explains technical topics in plain, friendly language.

title: Java Developer
description: Maintain Java services that support sample applicant tracking features. You will review pull requests and improve test coverage across the codebase.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Design clean layouts for job cards, filters, and recruiter dashboards. A mentored internship with weekly design reviews.

title: Sales Executive
description: Present the company's recruitment services to fictional client businesses and maintain the CRM pipeline. Includes a structured onboarding plan.

title: Marketing Intern
description: Draft social media posts and short articles about open roles. A six-month internship for a confident writer.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Design resilient system architectures for enterprise hiring platforms and guide delivery teams. A senior individual-contributor role.

title: React Native Developer
description: Build a mobile companion app that lets recruiters review posted jobs on the go. Contract engagement with a two-person mobile team.

title: Finance Associate
description: Reconcile vendor invoices and support monthly closing activities. Part-time schedule with flexible hours.

title: Data Entry Operator
description: Digitize paper application forms with high accuracy. This role was archived after the process moved to online submissions.
